summary: Run sheets for BW03_0098 (Belquorin Pharma, BP16 oxazole carboxamide series 16): plate acceptance, manual hERG patch-clamp IC50 for all 32 compounds with the E-4031 control, and the QC note on the five censored and two flagged records. Accepted 23 May 2003.

sheets.name: Summary

rows.v: BW03_0098 run sheets: BP16 protease programme, hERG patch clamp

rows: The lipophilic cap carried an ion-channel liability. Belquorin asked for less basic replacements rather than further testing of that branch.

comments.text: Top concentration 30 µM per the study plan. Compounds with no block at top concentration are reported as greater than 30 µM, not extrapolated.
comments.author: Ines Alvarado

sheets.name: Plate acceptance
rows: Acceptance: control inhibition within the historical band on each day, vehicle drift under the study plan limit, and seal resistance checked before each compound addition. No cell was carried forward after a failed control.

rows.v: Plate acceptance: all three runs accepted. Stability of the control is recorded per run in the sheet above.

comments.text: Rundown on HK-02 is within what we accept for this rig. Left in on purpose, flagged here so it is visible.
comments.author: Martin Ellerscombe

sheets.name: hERG IC50

rows.v: hERG IC50, automated patch clamp, cells 1 to 3 per compound

rows: Geomean reported where at least one cell gives a finite value. Censored records are shown with a greater-than sign and are not fitted.

sheets.name: QC notes

rows.v: QC notes on the hERG records

rows: Full set on one run sheet
Read against the 10 µM margin in the programme brief
Not fitted; reported as greater than 30 µM
Two records; repeat not requested by Belquorin
Note. The lipophilic cap is the common feature of the flagged records. Mechanism is not claimed here; the readout is the number.

comments.text: Counts are the screen gate for this set; the programme brief sets the 10 µM margin.
comments.author: Ravi Deshmukh
